message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
# make larger OR-chain candidates
for n in [1000000,2000000,5000000]:
    p=f'/workspace/poc_or_{n}'
    with open(p,'wb') as f:
        chunk=b'ip or '*10000
        for _ in range(n//10000): f.write(chunk)
        f.write(b'ip\x01')
    print(p)
PY
ls -lh /workspace/poc_or_1000000 /workspace/poc_or_2000000 /workspace/poc_or_5000000
